title: ASSESSMENT
description: The single JSON object Prompt B returns. A binary pre-screening verdict on a claim that intake validation has already accepted as complete. Nothing in this object represents an approved payment; Finance makes the final decision.
$comment: Member 5 must validate every Prompt B response against this schema BEFORE showing it. A response that fails validation is a SYSTEM ERROR, not a verdict: retry once, and if it still fails show an error rather than a fabricated pass or fail. Three checks a plain type check would miss: policy_ids may only contain well-formed IDs, so an invented citation such as ADMIN-999 is rejected; a passed result may not carry outstanding missing evidence; and a not_passed result must cite at least one policy, because a rejection without a rule is an opinion.

status.description: passed = every applicable policy requirement is met on the evidence supplied; still awaiting the Finance decision. not_passed = at least one applicable policy is violated. There is no third state: a claim that cannot be judged never reaches this module, because intake validation blocks it first.

policy_ids.description: The policy cards actually relied on. Every ID must appear in the retrieved evidence for this claim, and a not_passed verdict must cite at least one. The caller re-checks each ID against the retrieval result: the pattern here catches a fabricated citation such as ADMIN-999, not an irrelevant one.

rationale.description: Why this status follows from the cited policies, in terms of what the claim actually shows. No speculation about intent.

missing_evidence.description: Specific documents or facts the employee must supply. Concrete items only ('itemized hotel invoice separating room charges'), never a restatement of the status.

uncertainty.description: Residual observations the reviewer should see even though they did not change the verdict. Never a substitute for a decision.

next_action.description: One concrete step for the employee or for Finance. Must never state that payment is approved.
